description: This file defines the LDAPSyncException class used for handling specific LDAP synchronization errors in the OrangeHRM LDAP authentication plugin. It provides static methods to generate exceptions with meaningful messages related to LDAP sync issues.

classes.name: LDAPSyncException
classes.description: Custom exception class for LDAP synchronization errors, providing static factory methods for different error scenarios.

methods.name: nonUniqueWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee work email is not unique.

methods.name: nonUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee ID is not unique.

methods.name: userDNMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the user DN length exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: usernameMinLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the username is shorter than the minimum allowed length.

methods.name: usernameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the username exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: usernameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the username attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the first name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: firstNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the first name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: middleNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the middle name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: lastNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the last name attribute does not exist.

methods.name: lastNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the last name exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: employeeIdMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee ID exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: employeeWorkEmailMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee work email exceeds the maximum length.

methods.name: invalidEmployeeWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the employee's work email is invalid.
